newsitem.title: POLAND: AIB calls tender for WBK shares.
newsitem.headline: AIB calls tender for WBK shares.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks (AIB), which has 45.7 percent of Poland's Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy (WBK), has called a public tender offer for WBK shares at 14 zlotys each, the Warsaw bourse said in a statement on Wednesday.
WBK traded on Wednesday at 18.2 zlotys.
The bourse said it suspended trade in WBK on Monday because of the tender call.
According to an option agreement with the EBRD the Irish bank has the right to purchase all WBK shares held by the EBRD.
Earlier this month AIB acquired 6.5 million shares or 9.4 percent of WBK from the EBRD, increasing its stake to 45.7 percent. Before that purchase the EBRD had 23.9 percent.
WBK's buying of all shares held by the EBRD would put its WBK holding at 60.2 percent.-- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
